name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
grip: Pronated (overhand), holding dumbbell handles horizontally in front of the thighs.
description: Execute a bilateral hip-hinge Romanian deadlift holding two dumbbells, driving the hips back with a flat back and lowering the dumbbells to mid-shin level before returning upright.
setup: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs.
Soften the knees slightly and keep the shins relatively vertical.
Draw the shoulder blades back and engage the lats to keep weights close to the legs.
instructions: Initiate the movement by hinging backward at the hips, keeping the spine completely flat and neutral.
Lower the dumbbells vertically in front of the shins until reaching full hamstring stretch (approx. mid-shin).
Pause briefly without letting the dumbbells touch the floor or allowing the lumbar spine to flex.
Drive the hips forward to return to standing tall, squeezing the glutes at the lockout.
cues: Push the hips to the wall behind you.
Keep dumbbells shaving down the front of the shins.
Maintain a proud chest and neutral spine throughout.
commonMistakes: Squatting down by bending knees forward instead of hinging hips back.
Rounding the lower back to force extra depth.
Allowing dumbbells to drift away from the legs, increasing lumbar torque.

logging.example: Two 24 kg dumbbells: record 24 kg per dumbbell.
logging.note: Record the mass of an individual dumbbell rather than the combined total weight of both dumbbells.

variantNote: Bilateral dumbbell variation allowing independent wrist positioning while loading the posterior chain through a standard hip hinge.
reviewNotes: Drafted from FitTrack ID 144 (Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift).
Dumbbells reverse at mid-shin depth under control without touching the floor.
